description: This file sets up a Streamlit-based web interface for a SQL database chatbot using LangChain and OpenAI models. It includes environment configuration, database connection, language model and agent setup, a prompt template for user queries, and a chat interface with token counting.

classes.name: traceable
classes.description: A decorator for tracing function calls, imported from langsmith.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: A function that combines a prompt template with a user query, runs it through a chain, and tracks token usage.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that runs the Streamlit app, managing chat state, user input, and displaying responses.
